name: Santibáñez de la Peña (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided greyish green over white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santibáñez de la Peña (a tower on green above waves within a yellow frame).
history: Municipal flag of Santibáñez de la Peña; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Santibáñez de la Peña arms — tower on green above waves within a frame
frame and crown of the arms
